pages.title: Tiannan Demonic Market
pages.text: The Tiannan Demonic Market follows merchant_shops.json#tiannan_demonic_dual_market and uses the existing market system. It adds no separate merchant, faction-reputation screen, or loader, and trades in low-grade metal spirit stones.

pages.title: Current Stock
pages.text: The current listing is the dedicated Heqi Pill. It provides a dual-cultivation-compatible cultivation boost for 40 low-grade metal spirit stones, with stock 6 and a 48000-tick refresh.

pages.title: Planned Stock
pages.text: The corpus also lists dual_harmony_pill, demonic_yang_gather_pill, and demonic_blood_coral. They require dedicated pills, demonic materials, access risks, and reputation or karma rules, so they are not being forced onto generic substitute items.
